ev.q: A total of 11 cases were identified.
Eleven cases were identified during two outbreak periods
Births of nine (82%) of the infants were by cesarean delivery.
Eight (73%) of the 11 infants were hospitalized and treated with parenteral antimicrobials
Seven of the 11 patients had multiple affected body sites.
Symptom onset occurred at a median of 3 days
This report describes two independent investigations by local health departments, assisted by CDC

methods_quotes.q: A case was defined as an infection in a newborn aged <30 days delivered at hospital A
A case was defined as a culture-confirmed MRSA skin infection in a newborn delivered at hospital B
Isolates from the two HCWs and six of the 11 infants were available for characterization by pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE)
Characterization of the seven available MRSA isolates by PFGE
